cards.answer: Tryndamere is a fighter/assassin whose Fury increases his critical strike chance, while missing health increases his attack damage. He can dash into combat and temporarily prevent his health from falling below a minimum threshold.
cards.counterplay: Limit prolonged attack trades and create distance during Undying Rage.

cards.answer: Battle Fury generates Fury from basic attacks, critical strikes and enemy kills. Fury increases his critical strike chance and decays after he spends time without dealing or taking damage.
cards.counterplay: Be cautious of trades when his Fury is high; give it time to decay between fights.

cards.answer: Bloodlust passively increases his attack damage based on missing health. Its active consumes all his Fury to heal him, with more Fury providing more healing.
cards.counterplay: Respect his damage at low health and account for his healing before committing.

cards.answer: Mocking Shout reduces nearby enemy champions' attack damage. It also applies a curse that slows them while they face away from Tryndamere.
cards.counterplay: Face him when practical during the curse, and be cautious of attack trades while weakened.

cards.answer: Spinning Slash dashes to a target location, dealing physical damage and generating Fury for enemies hit. Critical strikes reduce its remaining cooldown, with a greater reduction against champions.
cards.counterplay: Keep distance from his dash path and limit his opportunities to keep attacking during a chase.

cards.answer: Undying Rage instantly grants Fury and temporarily prevents his health from falling below a minimum threshold. He can activate it while affected by crowd control that inhibits casting.
cards.counterplay: Create distance during the effect and save finishing damage for after it expires.
